channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mike Bibby | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mike Bibby from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Mike Bibby
item.description:
DeMarcus Cousins on jersey retirement in Sacramento:

“Obviously it would be an honor. That was something that I definitely wanted and strived for as far as why I tried to go out and perform every single night. Accolade-wise, I feel like I did all the right things while I was in that jersey … As far as All-Stars, as far as All-NBA selections, numbers, gold medals. I put my work in. I think I earned my stripes. Obviously it's like you (Mike Bibby) said, it's a political thing. But as far as the work being done, I think I did what needed to be done to join the others up in the rafters.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Mike Bibby, Aug 1, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Doug Christie on Mike Bibby
item.description:
Before Tuesday's game against the Milwaukee Bucks and riding a seven-game win streak, Christie was asked if any of his former teammates from his playing days have reached out to him about his then-7-1 record as interim head coach.

“Mike [Bibby] popped in the other day when we were playing [the] Miami [Heat] in the morning when I was working,”

Doug Christie on Mike Bibby, Jan 16, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Steve Francis on Mike Bibby
item.description:
“I love Mike Bibby, I love him, but there’s no way you were going to put me (on the floor) without the basketball in my hands,”

Steve Francis on Mike Bibby, Dec 28, 2022. Source: Toronto Star.

item.title: Steve Francis on Mike Bibby
item.description:
Francis said in an interview with the Star.

“If I ain’t going to have the basketball in my hands, I can’t wait for slow-ass Mike Bibby. I love him — excuse me — but I can’t wait for him.”

Steve Francis on Mike Bibby, Dec 28, 2022. Source: Toronto Star.

item.title: Rick Adelman on Brad Miller, Peja Stojakovic, Jason Williams, Mike Bibby, Bobby Jackson, Doug Christie
item.description:
Jason Anderson:Rick Adelman:

“We had Vlade. We had Chris. Players like Peja Stojakovic, who’s here today; Mike Bibby; Doug Christie, who’s here today; Bobby Jackson, who’s here today; Brad Miller. We also had Jason Williams, who’s here today. What a great group.”

Rick Adelman on Brad Miller, Peja Stojakovic, Jason Williams, Mike Bibby, Bobby Jackson, Doug Christie, Sep 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Steve Tebbs on Mike Bibby
item.description:
On his favorite memory at Sleep Train Arena: Tebbs:

“By far it would be Game 5 in the 2002 Western Conference Finals when [Mike] Bibby hit the shot. It’s funny because when I worked during the Finals at Golden State last season, Warriors fans would ask me, ‘Dude, is this as loud as Arco [Arena] was back in the day?’ and it’s comparable, but it will never be as loud as it was during Game 5. It was just one of those iconic moments that will forever live in Sacramento Kings lore that people will never forget.”

Steve Tebbs on Mike Bibby, Mar 31, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Peja Stojakovic on Chris Webber, Mike Bibby
item.description:
Peja Stojakovic on his favorite memories in the building:

“I have so many. But the shot Mike Bibby hit off of Chris Webber's hand off that sealed Game 5 in the (2002) Western Conference Finals was one of the biggest shots for our team.”

Peja Stojakovic on Chris Webber, Mike Bibby, Mar 19, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Mike Bibby
item.description:
Joseph Goodman:Dwyane Wade on tossing Mike Bibby's shoe:

“That was, I don’t know. I’ve never done that before but it was fun. I love messing with Bib.”

Dwyane Wade on Mike Bibby, May 1, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Mike Bibby
item.description:
#Knicks coachMike D'Antoni on Bibby:

“We think we still has some gas left in the tank. He’s a very smart, good shooting point guard.”

Mike D'Antoni on Mike Bibby, Dec 11, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: LeBron James on James Jones, Mike Miller, Mike Bibby
item.description:
“When I have new teammates, it’s a harder adjustment at the beginning because they’re not used to getting so many open looks. Mike Bibby, Mike Miller, [ James Jones] — these guys are getting so many open looks because me and D-Wade attract so many eyes.”

LeBron James on James Jones, Mike Miller, Mike Bibby, Mar 25, 2011. Source: Miami Herald.
